overview_description.description:
LendUp’s mission is to provide anyone with a path to better financial health. We build technology, credit products and educational experiences for the 56% of the US population who are shut out of mainstream banking because of poor credit or volatile incomes.

All of our technology is built in-house. We currently offer several types of credit products, including loans and credit cards. We embed education into our products, and where available, credit building opportunities, to help borrowers improve their long-term financial health and break out of vicious debt cycles.

We were founded by two step-brothers, CEO Sasha Orloff and CTO Jake Rosenberg. Sasha puts the “fin” in fintech, having worked at Citi, World Bank, and Grameen Bank. Jake puts the “tech” in fintech; he was a platform CTO at Zynga at 29 and began working at Yahoo! at age 16, as employee #80.

product.name: Loan Matching Service
product.description: An online platform that connects borrowers with direct lenders offering loans up to $5,000, considering all credit types including bad credit.

product.name: Payday Loans
product.description: Short-term loans designed to provide quick cash until the borrower’s next paycheck, typically repaid within 14 to 31 days without requiring good credit.

product.name: Installment Loans
product.description: Loans repaid over time through fixed monthly payments, offering longer repayment periods and more manageable payments than payday loans.

product.name: Direct Deposit Loans
product.description: Loans that are approved quickly and deposited directly into the borrower’s bank account, often within the same day or next business day.

product.name: Financial Education Courses
product.description: Free online video courses covering personal finance topics such as credit building, budgeting, and credit rights.
